title: ID0414013-DC/Si-D/NO-[170001580] Toggling pilot state (0-sessions)
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
PilotState toggling between B1-B2-E
Solution:
Customer is ending session via EV and this EV uses BCB toggle, as such, he is constantly trying to start a new session, fails since there is no BCB toggle hotfix and causes the 0-sessions

Problem Description
: PilotState toggling and causing several 0-sessions
Troubleshooting
: As we already aligned, these 0-sessions are caused by the EV or let's put it correctly, they way the customer is ending the session. Every time the customer ends a session it's via bus/truck as we see the source":"EV" from EcoG and this causes the EV to go into BCB toggle. If the customer stops the sessions via HMI it will not have this impact. As such I will close the ticket.
For future reference, your case number is
0414013
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
